fact: The National Treasury's sector report of November 2024 lists, under the State Department for ICT & Digital Economy, the project 'Implementation of Last Mile County Connectivity Network Phase IV & V' at KSh 7,800 million (650 million Government of Kenya, 7,150 million foreign) running 1 July 2022 to 30 June 2027, and reports 660 Last Mile County Connectivity sites maintained in each year 2021/22 to 2023/24 at 86 per cent uptime against a 99.9 target and 404 sites connected in 2023/24; it gives no count of county headquarters among the sites and does not say that county government offices are on the network.
title: Energy, Infrastructure and ICT Sector Working Group Report: Medium Term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) Period FY 2025/26 – 2027/28
publisher: The National Treasury and Economic Planning
